title: Timothy-grass harvest timing and nitrogen effects on press-liquid yield and composition
publication: Grassland Science in Europe, Volume 29, Why grasslands?, pp. 131-133
license_status: No explicit reuse license identified in the proceedings; retain source attribution and review redistribution rights.
source_location: Article 'Grass for biorefinery: Effects of N fertilization and harvest time on liquid yield and composition'; Table 1, pp. 132-133; methods, pp. 131-132

experimental_context.feedstock: Pure timothy (Phleum pratense), first and second cuts in 2023
experimental_context.harvest_schedule: First cut harvested 5, 12 and 19 June; second cut harvested 25 and 31 July and 7 August
experimental_context.fertilizer_treatments: First cut received 100, 130 or 160 kg N/ha in spring; second-cut area was harvested on 15 June and received 110 or 140 kg N/ha
experimental_context.replication: Three plot replicates per treatment and harvest date
experimental_context.sample_and_press_method: 15 m2 was harvested per plot; samples were frozen within 2 h, thawed for 48 h at 4 C, then 500 g was separated using a laboratory twin-screw Angel Juicer
experimental_context.reported_measurements: Grass dry matter; liquid yield per fresh-grass mass; liquid dry matter and ash; liquid yield and liquid nitrogen yield per hectare

column_basis.grass_dm_g_kg_fresh: g dry matter per kg fresh grass
column_basis.juice_yield_g_kg_fresh_grass: g press liquid per kg original fresh grass
column_basis.juice_dm_g_kg_liquid: g dry matter per kg press liquid
column_basis.juice_ash_g_kg_dm: g ash per kg press-liquid dry matter
column_basis.juice_yield_kg_ha: kg press liquid per hectare, as reported by the source
column_basis.juice_n_yield_kg_ha: kg nitrogen in press liquid per hectare, as reported by the source
column_basis.sem_*: Source-reported standard error of the mean for the corresponding cut-level response; repeated on each treatment row within the cut
column_basis.*_tukey: Source-reported Tukey significance-group letters; blank where the table reports no group letter

statistical_context: Source Table 1 notes Tukey group letters at P<0.05 and reports SEM separately by cut. The accompanying table-wide p-values and narrative ranges are not transcribed into this treatment matrix. Raw replicate values are not supplied.
data_handling: Direct transcription of Table 1 means, Tukey letters and cut-level SEM. No unit conversion, annualization, interpolation, or model parameter estimation was performed.
limitations: Cultivated pure timothy in Finland is not Dutch roadside grass; site, species, management, soil and weather differ.
Small laboratory twin-screw pressing is not a GreenHub pilot or industrial press and does not establish scale-up performance.
The reported fertilizer levels are experimental management treatments, not GreenHub fertilizer inputs or recommended rates.
Plot yield and liquid yield per hectare are study results, not contracted, accessible, collected or delivered GreenHub supply.
Only treatment means, group letters and SEM are available here; raw replicates and complete solid/liquid mass and component balances are absent.
The proceedings PDF did not identify an explicit reuse license.
